name: Lone Star Conference Cross Country Championships
headline: Lone Star Conference Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: West Texas A&M swept the titles, the men with 26 points over Texas A&M-International (70) and the women with 19 over Dallas Baptist (72). WT’s Meshack Keter won the men’s 8K in 23:51.9, and Lola Sarthou led a 1-2-3-4 WT finish in the women’s 6K in 21:16.6.
